description: RETIRED in 2.1.228: flipped the tengu_classifier_summary_kill gate default !1 -> !0 in JS. The boolean kill gate was replaced by the server-driven tengu_classifier_disabled_surfaces config; there is no local default to flip.
note: Searched 2.1.228 active dump: tengu_classifier_summary_kill still exists as a single pool constant (~35332744) but the surrounding mechanism changed — adjacent constants tengu_classifier_disabled_surfaces (~35332536), the surface list (bg/summary/watched/fanout/ccr/byoc/bridge/claude-desktop/desktop/cli/repl at ~35329808-35330112) and the log line '[classifier] tengu_classifier_disabled_surfaces: unknown surface' (~35334640) show the kill switch became a comma-separated server config parsed in bytecode. Renaming the gate/config constants only breaks the lookup (surfaces stay enabled) — the opposite of the intended effect — so no safe string lever exists.
